title: Sage attribute_gain record
description: A attribute_gain record (AttributeGainRecord). Generated by `sage schema` from the metadata table (issue #21).

$schema.description: The JSON Schema an editor checks this file with; the game ignores it.

id.description: The record's id: name (this file's namespace) or namespace:name. A second definition of an id is an error; change one with "patch".

base.description: Inherit every field from another attribute_gain record, resolved after patches; this record's own fields win.

patch.description: true: change a record defined earlier in load order, field by field, instead of defining one. Objects merge; lists replace unless written "field+" (add) or "field-" (remove).

abstract.description: true: a template, usable as a "base" and never built into a record itself.

disabled.description: true (in a patch): remove the record.

on.description: The moment it listens for: Hit, Hurt, Kill, Cast or Use. (AttributeGainEvent, default "Hit")

attribute.description: The attribute of whoever did it that gains (a skill's use-XP, experience) Names a attribute record. (RecordRef<AttributeRecord>)

amount.description: Added each time; clamped to the attribute's range. (float, default 1)

perDamage.description: Added for each point of damage the blow did (Hit and Hurt), on top of amount. At least 0. (float, default 0)

wielding.description: Whoever did it has one of these items equipped (a blade skill: the swords) Names a item record. Category: Only when. (List<RecordRef<ItemRecord>>)

wielding+.description: Adds to "wielding": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

wielding-.description: Removes these from "wielding" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

damageTypes.description: The blow was of one of these damage types (Hit and Hurt) Names a damage_type record. Category: Only when. (List<RecordRef<DamageTypeRecord>>)

damageTypes+.description: Adds to "damageTypes": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

damageTypes-.description: Removes these from "damageTypes" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

abilities.description: The ability cast was one of these (Cast) Names a ability record. Category: Only when. (List<RecordRef<AbilityRecord>>)

abilities+.description: Adds to "abilities": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

abilities-.description: Removes these from "abilities" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

items.description: What was taken was one of these items (Use) Names a item record. Category: Only when. (List<RecordRef<ItemRecord>>)

items+.description: Adds to "items": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

items-.description: Removes these from "items" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).
